title: From Mentorship to Momentum: How the Partnership Between Global Mentorship Initiative (GMI) and Concentrix Is Scaling Opportunity Globally
summary: As organizations navigate rapid transformation driven by technology and shifting talent needs, expectations for measurable social impact are rising.
body_markdown:
As organizations navigate rapid transformation driven by technology and shifting talent needs, expectations for measurable social impact are rising. Creating opportunities that are both meaningful and scalable in practice has become a shared challenge.


For nonprofits expanding access to education and career pathways, this challenge is even more visible. Increasingly, it’s clear that the most effective partnerships go beyond funding and create space to test and learn, enable co-creation, and build the capabilities needed to sustain impact over time.


That’s exactly what defines the partnership between Concentrix, Think Human Fund, and Global Mentorship Initiative (GMI).


**From Investment to Innovation**


When Concentrix and Think Human Fund first began supporting GMI, the goal wasn’t just to scale, but to create space for new ideas.


*“Concentrix did something rare: they gave us the freedom to try things, new projects, new initiatives, that had never been done before,”* said Ravenna Hennane, Senior Director of Development at GMI.


That trust translated into tangible impact. With support from Concentrix and Think Human Fund, GMI launched its French Language Program, expanding access to mentorship for Francophone students across Africa, introduced a Climate Leaders cohort that achieved a 95% completion rate in its first year, and began exploring how AI could enhance mentorship at scale.


Today, GMI operates in English, French, and Spanish, reaching more than 22,000 students across 152 countries including 8 refugee camps. 88% are hired within a year. The growth demonstrates how early investment in innovation can translate into meaningful opportunities for students around the world.


Reflecting on the partnership, **Philip Cassidy, President of Concentrix and Board Member of the Think Human Fund** , said:


*“The most impactful partnerships go beyond financial support. With GMI, we’ve had the opportunity to contribute expertise, explore how technology can enable greater reach, and support innovation that could help scale opportunity for students around the world.”*


**Scaling Impact Without Losing the Human Connection**


As GMI continued to grow, it faced a challenge familiar to many organizations: how to use technology to scale effectively while maintaining the human connection at the heart of the experience.


Through its partnership with Concentrix, GMI gained valuable insight into what sustainable technology integration really looks like.


*“The most valuable outcome wasn’t just a finished product,”* said Kristen Sahl, Director of Operations at GMI. *“It was a clearer understanding of what sustainable technology integration actually looks like.”*


The collaboration reinforced the importance of building technology with scale, usability, and long-term sustainability in mind. Those learnings are now informing GMI’s next phase of growth, including the exploration of agentic AI capabilities designed to enhance mentor and student engagement while preserving the personal connections that make mentorship so impactful.


**Turning Expertise into Impact**


The partnership also extended beyond funding into hands-on collaboration.


As GMI’s global community expanded, matching mentors and students became increasingly complex and time-intensive. To help address this challenge, Concentrix iX Delivery teams worked alongside GMI to explore how AI could support mentor matching while maintaining quality, trust, and meaningful human relationships.


Together, the teams conducted discovery workshops, defined requirements, and aligned stakeholders across product, legal, and go-to-market functions to assess what a scalable solution could look like within a nonprofit environment.


While the technical deployment was ultimately paused, the work delivered lasting value: a clearly defined solution framework, refined scope, and stronger alignment on how AI could support GMI’s long-term mission.


**Looking Ahead**


As GMI enters its next chapter, its focus remains clear: expanding its reach while preserving the quality and human connection that make mentorship transformative.


Future ambitions include exploring AI-driven matching capabilities to improve the speed and quality of mentor pairings, incorporating real-time feedback from students and mentors, and strengthening the systems that support a growing global community.


Concentrix mentors will continue to play an important role in that journey, helping students build confidence, develop career-ready skills, and access opportunities that might otherwise be out of reach.


More broadly, the partnership reflects a shift in how organizations create impact. Success is no longer defined by funding alone, but by how organizations share expertise, embrace innovation, and build solutions that create lasting opportunity.


For GMI, that means expanding access to mentorship for more students around the world. For Concentrix, it demonstrates how expertise, technology, and human connection can come together to help unlock potential at a truly global scale.
